claim: You have to get the ball on the tee in this snow globe ... - Reddit
summary: Tilt the globe away from you and let the ball come to a stop resting against the tee. With a small flick back to upright the ball will lift off with some spin. Immediately put the base flat on the table and the ball will climb over the edge of the tee and come to rest in place. With practice you can successfully put it in place with 5-10 tries.
